messages.subject: Re: Statistics in Medicine - Accept - Manuscript SIM-14-0772.R1
parts:
Hi stan developers. See below. We need someone to speak at a session at JSM in early Aug on Bayesian modeling of survey data using Stan. The survey data should be no problem.
Is there anybody who’s going to JSM who’d be interested in speaking in his session?
A


> On Jul 21, 2015, at 10:56 AM, Chen, Qixuan <qc2...@cumc.columbia.edu> wrote:
>
> Andy,
>
> Rob Trangucci just emailed me yesterday that he won't be able to give a talk in the topic-contributed session that I organized at this year's JSM. There are only two weeks from the conference, so it can be very hard to find a substitute. It is a session on "Bayesian modeling of survey data using Stan". Yajuan, my student Shar, and myself will speak. Joe Sedransk will be the discussant, and Shira Mitchell is the session Chair. Since it is a session about Stan, I am thinking of replacing Rob's talk with a 20-minutes Introduction/Tutorial talk on Stan as the first talk of the session. I asked Shira if she can give this introduction talk. She feels that she knows some of Stan but not an expert and would like to consult you and Daniel Lee on this. Actually it would be best if Daniel can make this trip and give this presentation. Please advise and I need to get back to the conference organizer to update the program book soon.
>
> Thanks!
> Qixuan
>
> -----Original Message-----
> From: Andrew Gelman [mailto:gel...@stat.columbia.edu]
> Sent: Monday, July 20, 2015 11:39 PM
> To: Chen, Qixuan
> Subject: Re: Statistics in Medicine - Accept - Manuscript SIM-14-0772.R1
>
> Good job!

A
